title: GPT-5.5 is generally available for GitHub Copilot
description: GPT-5.5, OpenAI's latest GPT model, is now rolling out on GitHub Copilot. In early testing, GPT-5.5 delivers its strongest performance on complex, multi-step agentic coding tasks and resolves real-world bugs more effectively.

title: Continue v1.3.38-vscode
description: Features include filter session history by workspace directory, .continue/configs support, and various dependency updates including handlebars 4.7.9 and happy-dom 20.8.9.

title: Inline agent mode in preview for JetBrains IDEs
description: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains IDEs now features inline agent mode in preview, along with enhancements to Next Edit Suggestions, global auto approve, and more flexible controls for terminal commands and file edits.

title: Copilot Chat improvements for pull requests
description: GitHub Copilot Chat now provides richer context and new capabilities when working with diffs and pull requests, accessible by asking a question about a pull request.

title: Better debugging with GitHub Copilot on the web
description: GitHub Copilot Chat in github.com helps you get to the root cause of an error faster when you paste a stack trace. Copilot recognizes stack traces more reliably and provides improved debugging assistance.

title: Continue v1.3.37-vscode
description: Includes ClawRouter as a provider for cost-optimized model routing, numerous bug fixes for JetBrains and VS Code including StringIndexOutOfBoundsException fix, and security vulnerability resolutions.

title: Background Agents in Slack
description: You can now launch Background Agents directly from Slack by mentioning @Cursor. Agents can read the thread, understand context, and create PRs in GitHub without leaving the conversation.

title: Windsurf 2.0: Introducing the Agent Command Center and Devin in Windsurf
description: Windsurf 2.0 brings the Agent Command Center and integrates Devin directly into Windsurf, enabling local and cloud agents to work together to ship more code efficiently.

title: Aider v0.56.0
description: Enables prompt caching for Sonnet via OpenRouter, 8k output tokens for Sonnet via VertexAI and DeepSeek V2.5, new /report command for GitHub issues, --chat-language switch, and --suggest-shell-commands controls. Aider wrote 56% of the code in this release.
